asset.assigned_to = null; lead.owner_id = null; recycle-bin has users snapshot; self-delete → 400; midhun DELETE /users → 403; (g) restart persistence: sudo supervisorctl restart backend, wait for /openapi.json 200, both accounts still log in, all collections still 0 (no reseed). Frontend (1920px): all 27 pages listed in spec load with zero pageerrors, no 'Something went wrong', no NaN. Module delete UI as admin@: /finance/subscriptions shows select-all-subscriptions + select-subscriptions-{id} + delete-subscriptions-{id}; RecordDeleteDialog copy contains 'permanent' and 'cannot be undone'; confirm enables after dependents load, toast '"T-UI-Sub" deleted — undo available for 24h in Settings', row disappears. Bulk on /finance/ledger: select-all-transactions → bulk-delete-transactions visible → dialog record-delete-confirm disabled initially, enables only after record-bulk-confirm-input='DELETE' → toast '2 deleted — undo available for 24h'. Single delete on /locations (delete-branches-{id}) confirmed. /logs shows purge-all-logs-btn → dialog purge-all-logs-dialog with purge-all-logs-input requiring DELETE → toast 'Purged 21 log entries — one audit entry recorded' and 'Logs Purged' entry visible. Midhun@ (admin): NO select-*/delete-*/bulk-delete-* on /finance/subscriptions or /locations, NO purge-all-logs-btn on /logs (permission default OFF). Employee delete E2E via UI: created uidel@ + assigned asset via API → /admin/users delete-user-btn-{id} + AlertDialog 'Delete' → user gone from /admin/users, /employees, /access; /assets shows asset-unassigned-{id} badge; deleted user login redirects back to /login. Mobile 360x740: /dashboard, /finance/subscriptions, /locations, /logs all scrollWidth=clientWidth=360 (no horizontal scroll). Settings page shows Role Permissions table with 'Clients — Delete' row (the new *.delete keys are visible).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_workspace.list_collections returns items with 'key'+'label'+'count' while /workspace/recycle-bin returns items with 'coll'. Inconsistent field naming across two closely related workspace endpoints — consider standardising on 'coll' (matches the DELETE_KEYS/PATH_PERMISSIONS grammar used everywhere else).
The (still-open) legacy issue from iteration 8 — routes_employees.update_profile uses raw role=='admin' check, blocking super_admin edits — remains. Not v2.5 blocker, but consistency debt.

Test harness had to sanitize one stale 'T-AI' subscription left behind by a previous manual/curl run; TestOnlyTwoAccounts.test_collections_empty is now sensitive to any stale record. Consider a post-test admin fixture that purges non-user collections between iterations (or a dedicated /api/admin/reset-demo super-admin endpoint) to make the empty-state contract self-healing across regression runs.
